recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-8081 follow-up is needed in core; future changes to this area should be handled under newer CapabilityStatement/profile guidance issues.
issue_request: FHIR-8081 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 FHIR-core profiling issue asking to consolidate the concept of profile and replace confusing profile short descriptions with clearer labels for use-case-supported profiles and the base system-wide resource profile.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 6087, represented in git by d737a985ffcaff8aea273127f6a5ca34910ad40b, which updated source/conformance/conformance-spreadsheet.xml to use the accepted FHIR-8081 descriptions for the then-current Conformance profile elements.
additional_context: Conformance has since become CapabilityStatement, which is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published FHIR-25462 work updated CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.profile, CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.supportedProfile, and profiling.html with clearer current wording while keeping the same distinction that FHIR-8081 sought to clarify.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current build source already conveys the resolved rule, and restoring the exact 2015 labels would undo later approved wording.
